exact_alert.finding: Published supplier lem-nrqm-composites-hilbert-tensor-construction, Proof 1.2, says the map (u,v)↦⟨u,u₀⟩⟨v,v₀⟩ “is $\mathbb C$-linear on $H\times K$”. It is bilinear, not linear on the product vector space: with H=K=C and u₀=v₀=1, its values at (1,1) and 2(1,1) are 1 and 4, rather than 1 and 2. The intended descent uses the induced additive map on the free presentation and the balanced bilinear relations; the quoted linearity assertion itself is incorrect.
